title: Adaptive Electromagnetic Transient-level Digital Twins for Data Centers via In-Context Learning with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.32882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) workloads has significantly increased data center (DC) power demand. Frequent operational and configurational changes, such as load surges caused by dynamic workload allocation, can induce electromagnetic transients (EMTs) whose accurate prediction is critical for reliable DC operation and maintenance. Although high-fidelity EMT solvers are widely adopted for transient analysis, their computational cost limits large-scale and multi-scenario studies. Digital twins address this computational bottleneck by emulating the behavior of a physical system and enabling fast prediction in place of expensive high-fidelity simulation. However,data-driven digital twins are non-adaptive and fail to generalize once the DC configuration changes. To address this limitation, this paper proposes an adaptive EMT-level digital twin for DCs based on in-context learning (ICL) with large language models (LLMs).

translated_title: 基于大语言模型上下文学习的数据中心自适应电磁暂态级数字孪生
translated_abstract: 人工智能工作负载的快速增长显著提高了数据中心的电力需求。频繁的运行和配置变更（例如动态工作负载分配引起的负载浪涌）可能引发电磁暂态（EMT），对其进行准确预测对于数据中心的可靠运行与维护至关重要。尽管高保真电磁暂态求解器被广泛用于暂态分析，但其高昂的计算成本限制了大规模和多场景研究。数字孪生通过模拟物理系统的行为，以快速预测替代昂贵的高保真仿真，从而解决了这一计算瓶颈。然而，数据驱动的数字孪生缺乏自适应性，一旦数据中心配置发生变化便无法泛化。为解决这一局限，本文提出了一种基于大语言模型上下文学习的数据中心自适应电磁暂态级数字孪生。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型上下文学习的数据中心电磁暂态级自适应数字孪生，克服了传统数据驱动数字孪生在数据中心配置变化时无法泛化的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive electromagnetic transient-level digital twin for data centers based on in-context learning with LLMs, overcoming the generalization limitation of conventional data-driven digital twins when data center configurations change.
